aiSamples.t: My laptop screen is flickering since morning, it is urgent, please copy my manager.
I need a flight from Mumbai to Bengaluru on 18 November for a client visit, returning on 20 November, and a hotel near Whitefield.
The AC on the 5th floor of Tower A is leaking water near meeting room Everest, please fix it today.
I need write access to the Finance shared drive for 30 days, my manager Sanjay will approve.
My October salary has not been credited yet, I am based in Pune, please keep Sanjay in CC.
I finished the Kubernetes Essentials course on LinkedIn Learning last week but I did not get the certificate.
Please merge the duplicate Orion Retail accounts, account name Orion Retail Ltd, opportunity 006Kx00000AbC12XYZ.
